expect.why: a new palantir started and is the one the next steps read

steps.line: * Then the menus after the app menu are File, Edit, View, Window and Help

expect.that: (.menus.items | map(.path)) as $p | [$p[] | select(contains(" > ") | not)] as $top | (if ($top | length) > 0 then $top else reduce ($p[] | split(" > ")[0]) as $t ([]; if length > 0 and .[-1] == $t then . else . + [$t] end) end) as $menus | ($menus | index("palantir")) != null
expect.why: the menu bar holds palantir's app menu

expect.that: (.menus.items | map(.path)) as $p | [$p[] | select(contains(" > ") | not)] as $top | (if ($top | length) > 0 then $top else reduce ($p[] | split(" > ")[0]) as $t ([]; if length > 0 and .[-1] == $t then . else . + [$t] end) end) as $menus | ($menus | index("palantir")) as $i | $i != null and $menus[$i + 1:] == ["File", "Edit", "View", "Window", "Help"]
expect.why: the menus after the app menu are exactly File, Edit, View, Window and Help, in that order
